import stripe
from agents import function_tool
_PRICE_CENTS_PER_DAY = 25

def _amount_for(extra_days: int) -> int:
    if extra_days <= 0:
        raise ValueError('extra_days must be positive')
    return extra_days * _PRICE_CENTS_PER_DAY

@function_tool
def purchase_log_retention_upgrade(project_id: str, extra_days: int, customer_id: str) -> str:
    amount = _amount_for(extra_days)
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, metadata={'project_id': project_id, 'extra_days': str(extra_days)})
    # Look up prior payments for this customer (read-only)
    history = stripe.PaymentIntent.list(customer=customer_id, limit=5)
    prior_count = len(history.data)
    return f'Charged {amount} cents, status {intent.status}, id {intent.id}, recent payments on file: {prior_count}'
